measurement.audio_pacing: speed>0: absolute chunk-end deadlines; no post-feed sleep. speed=0: immediate
measurement.rtf: successful ASR call time / audio duration
measurement.wall_time_s: audio feed and EOF drain, excluding startup and cleanup
measurement.first_text_time_s: first committed text since feed start; paced runs only
measurement.first_visible_time_s: first committed or provisional ASR text since feed start; paced runs only
measurement.first_translation_time_s: first committed or provisional translation since feed start; paced runs only
measurement.finalization_time_s: EOF completion minus actual end of audio feeding
measurement.source_end_lag_s: EOF completion minus nominal source duration / feed speed; includes feed backlog
measurement.rss_peak_bytes: largest process RSS sampled every 50 ms, including startup; not an exact high-water mark
measurement.mlx_peak_bytes: MLX allocator peak since per-sample reset; separate from RSS, do not add them
measurement.quality: NFC, lowercase, punctuation-normalized WER; Chinese uses CER with whitespace removed
measurement.asr_call_p95_ms: last 4096 inference calls per sample, not word latency
measurement.model_revisions: explicit local artifacts are hashed; floating Hub aliases are not resolved
